thesis: Measured duration, lived passage, causal ordering and temporal direction are related but distinct.
role: Connects physical time to memory and the politics of temporal measurement.

ideas.statement: Physical measurement and lived time answer different questions without canceling each other.
Relativity limits a universal present; determinism does not imply action is irrelevant.
Temporal arrows depend on boundary conditions and preserved traces; social clocks distribute burdens.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: A controlled-fall study distinguished retrospective duration from temporal resolution.
A fictional administration transfers more waiting to applicants while reporting efficiency.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: The block universe is an interpretation; entropy and information principles have specific domains.

audit.notes: Read every unit; fictional examples and limits retained. Structural transitions excluded from ranking.
